name: clerk_list_users
description: List Clerk users with optional email, username, or query filters and pagination.

name: clerk_get_user
description: Get a Clerk user by their user ID.

name: clerk_create_user
description: Create a new Clerk user with email, password, and optional metadata.

name: clerk_update_user
description: Update a Clerk user's name, username, metadata, or primary email/phone.

name: clerk_delete_user
description: Permanently delete a Clerk user and all associated data.

name: clerk_ban_user
description: Ban a Clerk user so they cannot sign in.

name: clerk_unban_user
description: Remove a ban from a Clerk user so they can sign in again.

name: clerk_lock_user
description: Lock a Clerk user account (prevents sign-in without banning).

name: clerk_unlock_user
description: Unlock a locked Clerk user account.

name: clerk_get_user_count
description: Get the total number of users in the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_get_user_by_email
description: Find a Clerk user by their email address.

name: clerk_get_user_by_external_id
description: Find a Clerk user by your app's external user ID.

name: clerk_list_user_sessions
description: List active or all sessions for a specific Clerk user.

name: clerk_revoke_user_sessions
description: Revoke all active sessions for a Clerk user, forcing them to sign in again.

name: clerk_set_user_password
description: Set or reset a Clerk user's password.

name: clerk_get_user_oauth_access_tokens
description: Get OAuth access tokens for a specific provider connected to a Clerk user.

name: clerk_list_user_memberships
description: List all organizations a Clerk user belongs to.

name: clerk_update_user_metadata
description: Update a Clerk user's public, private, or unsafe metadata.

name: clerk_create_email_address
description: Add a new email address to a Clerk user.

name: clerk_get_email_address
description: Get details for a specific email address object by its ID.

name: clerk_update_email_address
description: Update the verified or primary status of an email address.

name: clerk_delete_email_address
description: Remove an email address from a Clerk user.

name: clerk_create_phone_number
description: Add a phone number to a Clerk user.

name: clerk_get_phone_number
description: Get details for a phone number object by its ID.

name: clerk_delete_phone_number
description: Remove a phone number from a Clerk user.

name: clerk_list_organizations
description: List all organizations in the Clerk instance with optional member count.

name: clerk_get_organization
description: Get details for a specific Clerk organization by its ID.

name: clerk_create_organization
description: Create a new organization in Clerk for multi-tenant SaaS.

created_by.description: User ID of creator (auto-added as admin)

name: clerk_update_organization
description: Update an organization's name, slug, metadata, or membership limits.

name: clerk_delete_organization
description: Delete a Clerk organization and remove all memberships.

name: clerk_update_organization_metadata
description: Update an organization's public or private metadata.

name: clerk_list_organization_memberships
description: List all members of a Clerk organization with their roles.

name: clerk_add_organization_member
description: Add a user to a Clerk organization with a specified role.

name: clerk_update_organization_member_role
description: Change a member's role within a Clerk organization.

name: clerk_remove_organization_member
description: Remove a user from a Clerk organization.

name: clerk_list_organization_invitations
description: List pending or all invitations for a Clerk organization.

name: clerk_create_organization_invitation
description: Invite a user by email to join a Clerk organization with a specified role.

name: clerk_revoke_organization_invitation
description: Revoke a pending organization invitation.

name: clerk_list_organization_domains
description: List email domains that auto-enroll users into an organization.

name: clerk_create_organization_domain
description: Add an email domain to a Clerk organization for auto-enrollment.

name: clerk_delete_organization_domain
description: Remove an email domain from a Clerk organization.

name: clerk_list_sessions
description: List Clerk sessions filtered by user, client, or status.

name: clerk_get_session
description: Get details for a specific Clerk session.

name: clerk_revoke_session
description: Revoke a specific Clerk session, signing the user out of that device.

name: clerk_verify_session_token
description: Verify a Clerk session token and get its claims.

name: clerk_list_roles
description: List all custom roles defined in the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_create_role
description: Create a new custom role in Clerk for RBAC.

name: clerk_update_role
description: Update a Clerk role's name, description, or assigned permissions.

name: clerk_delete_role
description: Delete a custom role from the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_list_permissions
description: List all permissions defined in the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_create_permission
description: Create a new permission in Clerk.

name: clerk_delete_permission
description: Delete a permission from the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_list_jwt_templates
description: List all JWT templates configured in Clerk.

name: clerk_get_jwt_template
description: Get a specific Clerk JWT template by its ID.

name: clerk_create_jwt_template
description: Create a new JWT template to customize token claims for a service (Supabase, Hasura, etc.).

claims.description: Custom claims to include in the JWT

name: clerk_update_jwt_template
description: Update an existing JWT template's claims or lifetime.

name: clerk_delete_jwt_template
description: Delete a JWT template from Clerk.

name: clerk_list_allowlist
description: List all identifiers (emails, phone numbers) on the Clerk sign-up allowlist.

name: clerk_add_to_allowlist
description: Add an email or phone number to the Clerk instance allowlist.

identifier.description: Email address or phone number to allow

notify.description: Send invitation email to the address

name: clerk_delete_from_allowlist
description: Remove an identifier from the Clerk allowlist.

name: clerk_list_blocklist
description: List all identifiers blocked from signing up in Clerk.

name: clerk_add_to_blocklist
description: Block an email or phone number from signing up in Clerk.

name: clerk_delete_from_blocklist
description: Remove an identifier from the Clerk blocklist.

name: clerk_get_instance
description: Get the Clerk instance configuration including auth settings and enabled features.

name: clerk_update_instance
description: Update Clerk instance settings like support email, home URL, sign-in/sign-up URLs.

name: clerk_get_instance_restrictions
description: Get the current sign-up restrictions for the Clerk instance (allowlist, blocklist, email rules).

name: clerk_update_instance_restrictions
description: Update Clerk instance restrictions — enable allowlist, blocklist, block disposable emails, etc.

name: clerk_get_instance_organization_settings
description: Get organization feature settings for the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_update_instance_organization_settings
description: Update organization settings for the Clerk instance — enable orgs, set defaults.

name: clerk_list_webhooks
description: List all Svix webhooks configured for the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_create_webhook
description: Create a webhook endpoint to receive Clerk events (user.created, session.ended, etc.).

name: clerk_delete_webhook
description: Delete a webhook endpoint from the Clerk instance.

name: clerk_provision_org_with_owner
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a new organization and immediately add the specified user as admin — single-call tenant provisioning for multi-tenant SaaS.

name: clerk_offboard_user
description: SUPER TOOL: Fully offboard a user — revoke all sessions, remove from all organizations, and ban account in one call.

name: clerk_get_user_profile
description: SUPER TOOL: Get complete user profile — user object, all email addresses, phone numbers, organization memberships, and status in one call.
